fix: Do not build a HashMap per flight per frame. Add a non-allocating method on RouteHeroesInner, e.g. `fn enabled_member(self: &Rc<Self>, entry: &Rc<HeroEntry>) -> bool` that runs the same retain (drop dead or foreign weaks) and then `heroes.iter().filter_map(Weak::upgrade).any(|hero| Rc::ptr_eq(&hero, entry) && hero.enabled.get())`. Then in `tick` use: `let origin = if self.aborted || !self.manifest.to_route.0.enabled_member(&self.manifest.to_hero) { None } else { self.manifest.to_hero.location().map(|rect| rect.origin) };`. Keep the retain side effect.

The `flights` RefCell is mutably borrowed while the user-supplied flight_shuttle_builder runs (via `shuttle(context)`) and while user create_rect_tween callbacks run (via `tick`). A builder that reaches HeroFlights::tags() or any other method that borrows `flights` would panic. Clone the cheap Rc fields needed (Manifest is Rc-based) and drop the borrow before calling `shuttle`, e.g. collect `(manifest.clone(), rect, opacity)` into a pre-sized buffer under the borrow, then build the widgets after `drop(flights)`.

`Flight::start` and `divert` call `manifest.tween`, which runs the user-supplied create_rect_tween closure, while `flights` is mutably borrowed. A closure that re-enters HeroFlights panics on the RefCell. Compute the tween (and the Flight) before taking the borrow, or call the tween outside the borrow by computing the `HeroRectTween` values in the loop first and inserting under a short `borrow_mut`. Keep the same order of side effects.

Looking up one tag builds a full HashMap of every enabled hero in the route. Add a non-allocating `fn enabled_by_tag(self: &Rc<Self>, tag: &HeroTag) -> Option<Rc<HeroEntry>>` that scans `self.heroes` (after the same retain) with `find_map`, and use it here: `self.0.enabled_by_tag(tag)?.location()`. Same change for `is_in_flight` (`self.0.enabled_by_tag(tag).is_some_and(|hero| hero.placeholder.get().is_some())`).
The length is known: `let mut shuttles = Vec::with_capacity(flights.len());` (after the borrow, before the loop). This runs every frame while a flight is active.

Replace the index loop with `let ready: Vec<PendingTransition> = self.0.pending.borrow_mut().extract_if(.., |transition| { transition.waited += 1; transition.to.generation() != transition.generation || transition.waited > 2 }).collect();` (Vec::extract_if is stable). Removes the manual index and the O(n) remove calls, same order.
